mentions.name: JustRef
mentions.description: JustRef is a web app that acts as an AI referee for sports. It shipped a few days ago and reports over 2K sign-ups; it currently gives 1 free credit per sign-up so users can try it without paying.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on JustRef[1]: AI Referee for Sports. I shipped the product a few days ago and seeing more than 2K users have already signed up and using the web app.
